[[File:CROWN.jpg|thumb|150px|Darth Vader, with the Crown Jewels of Alderaan.]]
The '''Crown Jewels of Alderaan''' were one of the last surviving treasures from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They were the royal property of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] and were kept safely guarded with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] destroyed her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[File:Lderaancr.jpg|thumb|left|Princess Leia Organa presents the crown jewels as financial collateral.]]

Some three years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Leia used the jewels as collateral to finance a new squadron of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. She removed and kept her jewels in a safety deposit box at the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] hired the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]] to take out Viscount [[Tardi]] to distract Leia's attention while the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] achieved his true objective of stealing the crown jewels.

Sergeant [[Rolex]] was later assigned to investigate the theft.
